title: Point-and-Click Prototype
description: Basic movement, NPC interaction, quest completion with life cost, and death/rebirth cycle.
acceptance_criteria: Clicking on ground moves the player character to that position using pathfinding
Player stops moving when reaching the target position
Clicking an NPC opens a quest interaction panel
Quest panel shows quest name and a 'Take Quest' button
Taking a quest deducts 40 from Max HP
Completing a quest deducts 40 from Max HP immediately
Max HP displays on screen as 'HP: X / 100'
When Max HP reaches 0, player dies and restarts at level 1 with 100 Max HP
Facilities unlocked in previous lives remain unlocked after rebirth
